brief: Mary MacKillop was born in Melbourne in 1842. She became heavily involved in Catholic education of poor children in South Australia, and in 1867 set up an Order, the Sisters of St Joseph of the Sacred Heart, to further this work. The work expanded rapidly in many parts of Australia, and also in New Zealand where the first school was opened in 1883. The Order was not always popular with the authorities, but flourished nevertheless. Mary suffered a stroke while visiting Rotorua in 1901, but continued to run the Order till her death on 8 August 1909.
